title: Read the Codex MCP registration with --json: codex mcp get masks env values, so client and doctor report a correct atrium server as another instance
notes: Codex 0.171.0 prints 'env: SYNTOPICA_DATA=*****' in plain 'codex mcp get atrium', so mcp_server_status never finds SYNTOPICA_DATA=<data> and returns conflict. Seen on the office Mac 2026-11-24: 'syntopica client codex' exits 1 with 'reported success but no atrium server for this instance is registered' and doctor prints 'registered for another instance or checkout', while 'codex mcp get atrium --json' shows the right checkout and data path.
done_when: syntopica client codex prints 'registered mcp server atrium' and doctor prints 'registered for this instance' against Codex 0.171.0, with a test feeding the masked plain output.
